sentences.text: Heard Mr. Joshi, learned Counsel for the petitioner.
He submits that earlier the petitioner had been permitted to go abroad on four occasions.

Now the petitioner wishes to visit Italy, Belgium,
Dubai and China for a pleasure tour with his family from 4 th July 2024 to 10th August 2024, in view of the schedule given in para 3 of the petition.

sentences.text: Mr. Shetty, learned Special Public Prosecutor opposes the 1 of 2 903-11840-2024-WPst=.doc application on the ground that there is every possibility that the petitioner may not return to the country.

It would hamper the trial pending against him and others before the Sessions Court,
Mumbai for the offences punishable under Sections 304, 337, 338, 216, 285, 197, 198, 119, 420, 465,
466, 471, 34 and 36 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Since the learned Special Public Prosecutor himself is appearing before the trial Court, let the learned Special Public Prosecutor ascertain from the trial Court whether the charge will be framed in this case.

4. The trial Court shall inform as regards framing of charge against the accused on 6 th July 2024 as informed by the learned Special Public Prosecutor.
5.
Learned Counsel for the petitioner seeks to delete prayer clause (b).
Necessary amendment shall be carried out forthwith.

6. List on 2nd July 2024.
(PRITHVIRAJ K. CHAVAN, J.) 2 of 2 Kripesh Mansukhlal Sanghvi vs State Of Maharashtra on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112424324/
